## Logger

Single Responsibility: structured logging ONLY — no outbound alerting (that belongs to 04-notifications, which calls this workflow first, then sends its own Telegram/email alert).

Input: { level: 'DEBUG'|'INFO'|'WARNING'|'ERROR'|'CRITICAL', workflow: string, message: string, context?: object }
Output: the same, plus a timestamp — visible in this execution's log and in n8n's execution data for later auditing.
